infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sentinel needs the camera so you can photograph the result declaration form at your polling station.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sentinel needs photo access so you can attach a picture you have already taken.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sentinel needs the microphone so you can send voice notes to the command centre when typing is impractical.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Sentinel uses Face ID to unlock the app quickly and securely.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sentinel shares your location with the command centre while you are on duty, so they can reach you if you go silent or need help.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Sentinel shares your location with the command centre while you are on duty, so they can reach you if you go silent or need help.
